tips: Hoard shards, scrolls, essences and speedups between cycles and dump on the matching day.
Day 7 accepts all speedup types — leftover speedups go here.
rewards: Each day has 6 phases. Days 1–4: phase 1 = 15,000, phase 6 = 600,000 pts (2x Radiant Hero Choice Card).
Day 6 tops out at 800,000; Day 7 runs from 30,000 to 1,200,000.
Rank rewards need at least 100,000 personal points.
Card pool: Boyd (>0d), Monica (>4w), Kaios, Aerposia (>22w)
events.name: Ace Lord
events.summary: Seven daily themes; personal points unlock 6 reward phases ending in a Radiant Hero Choice Card.
rules: Runs Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 00:00 UTC.
Day 1 Heroes Assemble (hero upgrade)
Day 2 Path to Development (build & research)
Day 3 Daily Activity (stamina/AP & gathering)
Day 4 Training Master (training speedup)
Day 5 Draconic Stone (draconic stone & refinement crest)
Day 6 Supreme Power (obtain essences)
Day 7 Path of Eternity (build / research / training speedup)

tips: Day 4 Hero Growth overlaps nothing in Ace Lord — use leftover Bond Gifts.
Duel Moment: coordinate kills on Sat/Sun with Conquest of Lords.
rewards: Oskir shards (Gold league rank 1: 15x Oskir Shard, 5x Mythic Hero Covenant)
Day 1 phases run from 50,000 to 800,000 points
Daily rank rewards by league: Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold
events.name: Alliance Duel
events.summary: Alliance-vs-alliance daily themes running on different days from Ace Lord in the same week.
rules: Day 1 Rune & Holystone
Day 2 Dragon & Totem
Day 3 Draconic & Glory
Day 4 Hero Growth
Day 5 Dragon Crystal & Curio
Day 6–7 Duel Moment (kill troops)
Ascending/salvaging runes gives 0 pts on Day 1 — only obtaining essences/spinels/crystals/scrolls scores.

tips: Days 6–7 are diamond spending only — buy what you need in the Diamond Shop now, not earlier.
rewards: Ace Hero Choice Card I/II/III by realm age
Card pool: Apan, Norris, Patty, Angelita (>22w)
events.name: Arms Race
events.summary: Daily-themed personal race in the opposite week to Ace Lord. Final phase grants an Ace Hero Choice Card.
rules: Day 1 Hero Upgrade
Day 2 Development + Rune & Holystone
Day 3 Enhance Gear + Forbidden Treasures Arms Race
Day 4 Dragon Points & Totem
Day 5 Draconic Stone & Glory
Day 6–7 Consume Diamond

tips: Use the Bag Hoard calculator to time your dump with the parent day.

events.name: Royal Arms Race
events.summary: Three themed windows per day (00:00–07:55, 08:00–15:55, 16:00–23:55 UTC), Thursday to Sunday.
rules: Each window draws a random theme from a fixed set for that time of day.
00:00–07:55: Curio, Gear & Totem, Hero Upgrade, Rune & Holystone, Train/Build/Research Speedup.
08:00–15:55: Curio, Draconic Stone, Obtain Treasure, Research, Stamina/AP, Troop Training Power.
16:00–23:55: Build & Build Speedup, Building/Research/Training Power, Curio, Diamond Consumption, Military & Civil Dragon Pts.
The wiki Royal Arms Race page says Thu–Sun; its Events grid shows Thursday only.

rules: Dragon EXP items and Dragon Stone usage score.

events.name: Forbidden Treasures Arms Race

rules: Gear Essence spent scores; overlaps Arms Race Day 3.

tips: Pre-queue a long training batch Wednesday night and finish it Thursday with speedups.
events.name: Army Expansion
events.summary: Troop training milestones.
rules: Points per troop trained, scaled by tier.

tips: Bring DoT (poison/burn) and multi-hit heroes — crowd control does nothing.
events.name: Elemental Seal I / II / III
events.summary: Boss challenge requiring specific elements and minimum star levels.
rules: Deploy the required element(s) at or above the stated star level.
Boss uses skills from Round 11+ and is immune to stun and silence.
Only your highest single run counts for Top 50 rank.
Elemental Seal I phase 1 is 125 points.

events.name: Lich Attack
events.summary: Attack the Lich King with 10x march speed and zero soldier losses (Citadel Lv. 6+).
rules: Citadel Lv. 6+.
No troop losses — attack as often as attempts allow.
Top 50 damage ranking.

events.name: Personal Activity
events.summary: Personal activity point track.
rules: Daily quests and stamina use score.

tips: Lead gather marches with Gina.
events.name: Gather Resources
events.summary: Gathering race.
rules: Resources gathered from the map score.

events.name: Diamond Redeem Shop
events.summary: Spend diamonds / vouchers on Curio Scroll Chests and rare materials.
rules: Limited stock per item.

events.name: Alliance Showdown
events.summary: Shared alliance quest list across Novice, Adept, Master and Legend leagues.
rules: 20+ members, Citadel Lv. 15+.
Quests are shared — claim the ones you can complete.

events.name: Undead Scourge
events.summary: The alliance Leader or a Diplomat starts a 20-wave undead defence with 5-minute prep.
rules: Started by the alliance Leader or a Diplomat; 5-minute prep.
20 waves; no resources are lost and most wounded units are healed afterwards.
Arcane Barrier does NOT block undead attacks.
Failing twice stops attacks on your castle — reinforce allies for points.
The event ends once every ally has failed twice.
Alliance Fortress Boss defence at the end.

events.name: Oblivion War
events.summary: AvA map: capture Gate of Demise, Ancient Ruins, Magic Altar, Temple of Life and Camps.
rules: Sign-up needs at least 10 members with Citadel Lv. 18+.
Occupy a structure for 3 minutes to control it; control earns Time Points.
Wounded go to the Battlefield Hospital and return when you leave the battlefield.
The alliance with more Time Points wins; both sides get rewards.
Oblivion Pyramid spawns the Titan Colossus.

events.name: Strike Out
events.summary: Whole-alliance milestone track; phase targets run from 600,000 to 15,000,000 points.
rules: Points come from the whole alliance: consuming stamina, defeating monster dens and event-summoned monsters.
Stamina = 600 pts each (not verified).
Monster Dens Lv. 1–45 = 4,500–18,000 pts (not verified).
Personal ranking: top 100 members. Alliance ranking: top 50 in the local Battle Division.

events.name: Fort Contest
events.summary: Register 1 Fort + 1 Fortress, vote 3 of 5 time slots, then fight a 2-hour battle phase.
rules: Alliances with 20+ members register; Citadel Lv. 10+ (not verified).
Each alliance votes 3 of 5 time slots; the most-chosen slot becomes the battle period.
Battle phase lasts 2 hours. Holding a Fort for 30 minutes takes control; otherwise the longest holder wins.
Fighting causes wounded soldiers. Members cannot leave the alliance during the contest.
Wiki Events page: every other Saturday (app previously: every Saturday). The week parity is not known, so the calendar still shows every Saturday.

events.name: Infernal Gate
events.summary: Rally the Infernal Emissary Lv. 1–25 (20k to 120M HP).
rules: 71-hour personal participation cooldown.
Rewards depend on damage dealt.
Lords who leave the alliance after joining cannot rejoin the event.

events.name: Alliance Trial
events.summary: Cooperative alliance trial stages.
rules: Each member contributes attempts.

events.name: Alliance Party
events.summary: Social points event.
rules: Join the party for points and shared rewards.

events.name: Alliance Defense
events.summary: Defend alliance territory against waves.
rules: Reinforce weaker members.

events.name: Shadow Expedition
events.summary: Alliance expedition on a shadow map.
rules: Clear nodes as an alliance.

events.name: Dragon Arena / Clash
events.summary: Alliance node deployment and bracket PvP.
rules: Deploy dragons to nodes; brackets resolve automatically.

events.name: Conquest of Lords
events.summary: Cross-realm war for the Hall of Might and 4 Spires.
rules: 8-hour consecutive hold of the Hall of Might auto-wins; otherwise longest occupation.
Spire cannons fire every 10 minutes for 1% garrison loss.
Enchanted Woodland boundary grants protection.
30% of structure garrison losses become permanent deaths.
12,000 personal score target.
Trophy Grades and a 9-Realm League.
Realm points: 100 per Realm colonized; 25 if never colonized and colonizing no one; 0 if colonized.
Ties are broken by Realms colonized, then by which Realm was colonized less.

events.name: Realm Expedition
events.summary: Teleport into enemy realms to pillage and kill.
rules: Realm Hospital protects wounded.
8,000 Diamond Mine gathering cap per Lord.
Personal points also come from gathering in a foreign Realm.

events.name: Scorching Front
events.summary: Single-session volcano battle for Fire Crystals.
rules: 1 Fire Crystal = 1 point.
3 free teleports, then scaling diamond cost.
Goblin Rocket and Shield map pickups; central supply chests.
Realm Hospital fully heals for free after the event.

tips: Use the 30-second lookup tool in this app.
events.name: Sophia's Test
events.summary: 15 trivia questions, 30 seconds each.
rules: Rewards depend on accuracy and time used; extra rewards need a set number of correct answers.
Quitting mid-test counts the current question as wrong; you can resume from the next one.
Alliance help button available.

events.name: Lucky Flip

rules: Lucky Coins do NOT expire — saving 50 guarantees the Grand Prize.
